job_statement: When I need to know about new features, bug fixes, and known issues in KMM versions, I want to review release notes, so I can plan upgrades and understand changes in KMM Operator.
module_note: reference: new features, bug fixes, known issues and a deprecation -- the most complete of the set
job_notes: Partial. The release notes themselves are complete and well modularized -- seven REFERENCE modules, one per KMM version, all in hardware_enablement/kmm-release-notes.adoc. Two things the job statement asks for are missing. First, the three content types are uneven across versions: 2.2 and 2.3 carry new features only, with no bug fixes and no known issues sections; 2.4.1 and 2.5.1 carry known issues but no bug fixes. Only 2.4, 2.5 and 2.6 come close to the full set. Second, the "so I can plan upgrades" half of the job has no supporting content: there is no KMM Operator to {product-title} version compatibility matrix module, and no procedure for upgrading the KMM Operator itself. modules/kmm-installing-older-versions.adoc is the closest thing to version-selection guidance, and modules/kmm-customizing-upgrades-for-kernel-modules.adoc covers upgrading the kernel modules KMM manages during a cluster upgrade, not upgrading the Operator.
